title: 7/06-8/14: a private_locked or locked_unconfirmed commit whose best-effort decision.json write failed got neither an entry alert nor the missed-pick alert
tier_reason: multi-fault path with no evidenced firing; the missed-pick half was closed 8/14 (224ddce), but the entry check still skips such a commit and local grading/polling skip it too (same is_scoreable_commit gate); B -> A

contract.text: A committed pick that needs manual entry (private_locked or locked_unconfirmed) always yields an operator alert while its entry is unconfirmed, even if the best-effort decision.json write failed.
contract.source: docs/audit/2026-07-06-deferred-dd-and-premature-entry-alert.md 'Codex pre-merge review ... Deferred' (finding 1); ARCHITECTURE.md 'bts check-pick-entered' ('Former residual limitation ... closed 2026-08-14')

mechanism.text: check_pick_entered gates on daily_decision.is_scoreable_commit: with no decision record it falls back to pick_was_delivered, which is False for private_locked and locked_unconfirmed commits, so a failed decision write silences the entry check (by design: the pick_locked union was rejected)
_write_commit_decision set state.committed_pick_written = True even when write_decision failed, which suppressed the E3 missed-pick alert (step 5b gate) for the same day

residual.text: The entry check still skips a commit whose decision record is missing; the alert now comes only from the in-process E3 check, which shares the scheduler's fate (I-206)
check-results and the daemon's result polling use the same is_scoreable_commit gate, so such a commit is never graded locally (code reading; no source discusses it)
residual.source: src/bts/cli.py check_results and src/bts/scheduler.py run_day polling gate at 4490aee

watchdog.trigger: for a date whose pick carries delivery_attempted, or was privately locked, but has no decision.json: no entry confirmation or operator alert by the cutoff
watchdog.recovery_assertion: an alert is delivered and the date gains a scoreable decision record or an explicit operator note

evidence.locator: docs/audit/2026-07-06-deferred-dd-and-premature-entry-alert.md 'Codex pre-merge review of the fix (round 2)' Deferred (540b1ab)
evidence.what: private_locked/locked_unconfirmed with a missing/failed decision.json (HIGH): the fallback pick_was_delivered is False for those states, so the alert would be suppressed; narrow (multi-fault; private mode unused in dm config); the union with state.pick_locked rejected
'Former residual limitation ... closed 2026-08-14: committed_pick_written is no longer set on a failed write, so the E3 missed-pick alert fires'
_write_commit_decision sets committed_pick_written only when write_decision returned a record; 'a flag with no record behind it suppressed E3 while leaving nothing for polling'
